canvas-cream.$description: Canvas Cream — Page background base — the warm off-white that gives the interface its sunlit feel

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Card surfaces, elevated panels, input fields — pure white for content containers

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Dark supporting neutral for text, icons, and strong contrast. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Secondary text, button text on dark fills, heading weights

graphite.$description: Graphite — Tertiary text, muted descriptions, secondary button text

steel.$description: Steel — Placeholder text, disabled states, low-emphasis body copy

ash.$description: Ash — Icon fills at rest, muted helper text, tertiary icons

fog.$description: Fog — Input borders at rest, subtle dividers, inactive form controls

mist.$description: Mist — Hairline borders throughout — the workhorse divider color

slate.$description: Slate — Muted body text, secondary icon strokes, meta information

ember-orange.$description: Ember Orange — Orange supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

ember-glow.$description: Ember Glow — Lighter orange for hover states on ember elements, soft accent fills

ember-deep.$description: Ember Deep — Dark orange for icon strokes and decorative accents needing depth

signal-blue.$description: Signal Blue — Decorative icon accent, link highlights, informational touches — the secondary chromatic note

terminal-green.$description: Terminal Green — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

alert-red.$description: Alert Red — Red supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

warm-sunrise.$description: Warm Sunrise — Gradient endpoint for the hero's warm peach wash — the signature atmospheric gradient

satoshi.$description: Display headlines — the custom Satoshi at medium weight creates a rounded, friendly authority at hero scale; its geometric softness contrasts with Inter's utilitarian precision

inter.$description: Primary UI font — handles body text, nav items, buttons, form labels, section headings; weight 500 for nav active states and subtle emphasis, 600-700 for subheadings; tight 1.25-1.43 line-height at body sizes keeps the compact density working

geist-mono.$description: Short URL display, code snippets, technical metadata — monospace where data precision matters (the shortened link, the click counter)
